items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Encode tildes consistently with pathToFileURL**

When the repository path contains a literal `~`, Node's `pathToFileURL` serializes it as `%7E`, while jq's `@uri` here leaves `~` unescaped; the URL-side normalization also preserves the existing `%7E`. The equality therefore never matches the already-open tab, causing the hook to open another pane on every map write instead of reloading it. Normalize both sides with equivalent URL encoding.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Resolve relative paths from the physical working directory**

When the hook runs from a checkout reached through a symlink and the tool reports a relative path such as `./.project-map/index.html`, `$PWD` retains the logical symlink path, while terminal-browser's Node `pathToFileURL` conversion resolves it against the physical `process.cwd()`. The resulting paths never compare equal, so every later map write opens another pane instead of reloading the existing tab; derive the absolute event path using the same physical-directory semantics as terminal-browser.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->
